title: Path Planning: Balancing Pseudo-Puzzle Design and Multi-Solution Trade-offs
subtitle: This article deconstructs pseudo-puzzle mechanics and solution space design, analyzing how to build an open solution space using limited game mechanics. It details verifiable generation techniques to maintain logical consistency while precisely balancing the fun of multi-solution exploration against the efficiency of single-solution guidance, offering developers core strategies for controlling randomness.
